{{Top|leg}}
The '''Latecomers''' were one of the three major social groups who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nam Chorios/Legends|Nam Chorios]], the others being the [[Oldtimer]]s and [[Newcomer]]s. The Latecomers were the settlers who arrived on the planet after the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] took control of the world.<ref name="conviction">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Conviction]]''</ref>
